column2: Humans are creatures who fight one another... No matter how you struggle... in the end... they'll destroy... them...selves...
Akira...
Do you think what he said is true, Ryo?
Humans who learn the Demons exist will be gripped by fear. Gripped by suspicion, there's no telling what they'll do...
Humans have the courage and smarts to hold down their fear and fight!
That's right! Ryu Takuma is a perfect example!
...We got way sidetracked!\n\nThe showdown between the Slum King and Jack is about to start!
Heeelp...
It huuurts...
How horrible...
Kakakaka. Do you hate me? Then hate me! Being hated is a point of pride for a Demon! The stronger you are, the more they hate you!
I won't forgive you, Jinmen!
Wh-what an incredible fight...!
I stole the body of a Demon, the warrior Amon... and even I'm shaking just watching these two fight! Who the hell are those guys!?
The Dragons are on the move! Let's back Jack up!
It's shaking like crazy!
The Kanto Hellquake all over again...!?
Thank goodness! Everyone's okay!
Takuma-kun!
Gyaaah!
Aaargh! Whoaaa!!
A huge victory, thanks to your help! Thank you!
It's a victory for Takuma-kun and all the kids!
Heh heh! Yeah, you're right!
Is that so?\n\nWhat would you do if the real battle is only starting now?
There's a rumor that after you leave, only corpses are left behind. But we won't die! We'll prove that rumor wrong!
If you muster every ounce of courage you've got,\n\nyou can get through any pinch!
I think so too!\n\nI'm going to find {s} no matter what!
{p}! I'll help you!
I'm glad, but what about the Quake Fort...?

We drove off the Gedo Gang and dealt the Dragons a heavy blow! Now people will respect the Quake Fort.

And if we get attacked, we've learned that if we all pull together like today, there's nothing to be scared of!

We'll be fine leaving this place for a while!
Then I'll come too...
Any objections?
No, not at all!
It's just, we're wondering why...
I don't know who he really is or what he's after, but there's no man stronger than Violence Jack! You can relax, {p}! But...
...But?
Better not trust Violence Jack. Come on, let's go!
Nobody at the checkpoint?\n\nDid the Slum King lose to Jack and run off?
...I wonder what's past the checkpoint. {s}... I hope she's okay...
They say the north checkpoint's open too! Can we go anywhere we want now?
Have you heard about the mountain northwest of the slums? They say there's a Lost Forest nobody comes back from alive.
Weird... There's supposed to be a housing area around here. Heeey, Miki-chaaan!
...Don't tell me it's the Demons' doing?
That's not certain yet.\n\nBesides, I don't see a housing area anywhere.
We're in a forest, after all... Let's walk around a little. Maybe we'll figure something out?
Yeah...
...It's like a town from another world!
Take a good look, Akira!\n\nIf the Demons take the world, this is what the surface will become!
But this town looks peaceful to me.\n\nNo earthquake hit it, and no Demons attacked it.
Whatever world this is, we need to look into it more...
Woo-hoo! I'm so glad you asked! Would you believe a mansion was floating in the pond!?
A mansion in the pond? You're not messing with us, are ya?
Aww, you DO doubt me!!
If you're jerking us around, I won't go easy on you!
Well?
...It's true!\n\nNot once or twice, either. I've seen it lots of times!
Hold it!
Anything else?
When the mansion floats on Hasunuma, is there any kind of trigger?
Now that you mention it, a black moon comes up, I think...
A black moon!?
These people are scaaary!
Did you hear that?
A black moon, he said.\n\nShould we look around more, or head back to the pond...?
Jack, what are you looking at?
Kyusei High School?
Awfully lively. Some kind of school festival?
Nope! Look at that.
A Brawl Festival? What's that!?
Sounds like a blast!
The Demon blood stirs...
What're you guys doing? The finals tournament's about to start!
...Let's see, all the other teams are here, so you guys must be the Chizakura Gang.
The venue's the gym. Naojiro's in front of it. He was all worked up, so you'd better hurry!
The Chizakura Gang got almost wiped out...\n\nThere's no brawler to team with Kikunosuke, so they're about to forfeit!
The Chizakura Gang? Naojiro? ...No idea what's going on, but we'd better head to the gym...
What're you going to the school building for in the middle of the Brawl Festival? The venue's the gym. Fighters and spectators, head over there!
The Way of the Brawl, rule one! Scare 'em with your face! GRAAAH!
Naojiro, what are you doing?
Teachin' the secrets of brawlin'...
To who!?\n\nOur whole team got wiped out in the qualifiers!
Heh heh heh...
Um... someone told us to go to the Chizakura Gang...
Ohh! You're with the Chizakura Gang! Great, great! Now we can enter the finals!
All right, Naojiro!
Hm? Don't recognize your faces. Transfer students?
Well, um...
I'm Naojiro Abashiri!\n\nAnd this here's my little sister, Kikunosuke. Kikunosuke Abashiri!
Nice to meet you! I'm {p}!
The finals tournament is split into two blocks. We're in Block B! Three fighters per team! Once you've picked your members, get your butts to the venue!
The Brawl Festival venue is the gym!\n\nOnce you've picked your members, get your butts to the venue!
Kyusei's famous Brawl Festival!\n\nI look forward to it every month, I do!
They say the winner gets to fight a grizzly bear! Last time's winner fought a lion! ...Got eaten, though.
One fierce fight after another. Just watching, I might have a heart attack...
As a parent, it's only right to see my child's fights through!
The villainous, ruthless Abashiri Family!\n\nThey say the Chizakura Gang's got their second son and eldest daughter!
